svg.title: Example Gadfly report with three ranked objections and fixes

g.text: The post claims 2x productivity but gives no metric or baseline. It reads as a feeling.
FIX Add one number: tasks shipped per week, before vs. after.
Two weeks, one person, one job. Readers will say it won’t work for them.
FIX Say it’s your experience, and name who it may not suit.
“So you just swapped apps for sticky notes?”
The post never says what replaced the to-do app, so the claim feels incomplete.
FIX Describe your replacement system in two sentences.

svg.text: ranked by severity · each objection ships with a fix · evidence tagged real vs. simulated
